name: Punk Rocker

features.name: xWays
features.description: Stretch reels up to six high, or 20 for characters.

features.name: Riot Respin
features.description: Locked wilds and an unlocked sixth reel.

review:
The original 6x3 punk game. xWays mystery symbols hold two to four symbols and stretch the reels up to six high, and punk characters can super-expand up to 20 symbols high. Molotov Wilds expand upward.

Two scatters trigger the Riot Respin, which locks the Molotov Wilds and unlocks a sixth reel. High volatility, 15,072x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
